title: Sustainability criteria for plastic recycling technologies

triage.reason: The Commission's Have Your Say page shows a feedback consultation (closed 16 Sep 2026) on a planned delegated decision setting sustainability criteria for plastic recycling technologies used in packaging, a recent step under the PPWR framework.

draft.summary: A public feedback period on the delegated act establishing sustainability criteria for plastic recycling technologies ran from 14 August 2026 to 16 September 2026; feedback is closed.
